subject: Provisioning & Access Validation Package for SOC 2 — Fenix Health
messages:
From: IT Audit <it.audit@fenixhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Fenix SOC2: request for provisioning logs and access controls

Hi Jasmine,

As part of our upcoming SOC 2 readiness review we need a short package showing how provisioning and access control are handled for the Fenix Health integration. Specifically we'd like the following:

- Confirmation of SSO (SAML) configuration and a copy of the current metadata XML
- A recent SCIM user export showing delta sync with timestamps (last 30 days)
- RBAC/permission matrix for the roles used by Fenix (what permissions each role grants)
- Recent provisioning/change logs (create/update/deprovision) for a 30-day window
- Any runtime controls that enforce least privilege (examples, not more than 2-page summary)

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Friday (2026-07-03)? If there are format preferences (CSV, XLSX, PDF) let us know. We may follow up with a short walkthrough call.

Thanks,
Manpreet Singh
IT Audit — Fenix Health

--Attachment: SOC2_Request_Scope.pdf (pdf)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Manpreet Singh <m.singh@fenixhealth.com>, IT Audit <it.audit@fenixhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fenix SOC2: request for provisioning logs and access controls

Hi Manpreet — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for; plan below.

Deliverables (targeted):
- SAML metadata XML (SAML_Metadata_redwood.xml) — export from our identity gateway
- SCIM user export (SCIM_UserExport_20260629.csv) + short note on delta procedure and timestamps
- RBAC matrix (RBAC_Matrix_v1.xlsx) with mappings to internal permission IDs
- Provisioning/change log slice (30-day window) as CSV with UTC timestamps
- 2-page controls summary describing enforcement points for least privilege and scoped tokens

Quick question: do you prefer the logs with user IDs masked or full emails? We typically provide full emails in the audit package but can mask on request.

I'll upload a packaged bundle to a shared Drive link and attach a zip to this thread once the compile is complete. If you'd like a walkthrough, I can set aside 30 minutes on Thu morning — I can invite our IAM engineer (Karthik) and the implementation lead (Soojin).

Thanks — Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
(Attachment stubs referenced in final package)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fenix SOC2: request for provisioning logs and access controls

Jasmine — tagging with artifact locations and a couple of notes.

Artifacts are in the internal compliance drive folder (read-only link included in related_links). File names (finalized):
- RBAC_Matrix_v1.xlsx — includes role -> permission mapping and examples for Fenix service accounts
- SCIM_UserExport_20260629.csv — includes attributes synced (email, external_id, status, last_synced_at)
- provisioning_logs_20260601-20260630.csv — create/update/delete events with operator_id and timestamp (UTC)
- SAML_Metadata_redwood.xml — current metadata for the integration (entityID, ACS, x509)

Notes:
- The provisioning logs capture operator_id (internal id) and external_email. If you need email addresses unmasked we can provide them; currently audit export uses full emails by default.
- RBAC mapping references internal permission IDs (p- codes). I included a short lookup sheet mapping p- codes to human-readable actions.

I'll attach RBAC_Matrix_v1.xlsx in a follow-up internal note; final consumer zip will include the lookup and a controls_summary.pdf.

Karthik
Senior IAM Engineer — Redwood Inference
--Attachment: RBAC_Matrix_v1.xlsx (xls/xlsx)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Manpreet Singh <m.singh@fenixhealth.com>, IT Audit <it.audit@fenixhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fenix SOC2: request for provisioning logs and access controls — package delivered

Hi Manpreet / team —

Per our plan, attached is the provisioning & access validation bundle for Fenix Health (provisioning_bundle_20260630.zip). Contents (top-level):
- SAML_Metadata_redwood.xml (SAML metadata export)
- SCIM_UserExport_20260629.csv (SCIM export, includes provisioned/active/inactive flags and last_synced_at UTC)
- provisioning_logs_20260601-20260630.csv (30-day event slice: create/update/deprovision)
- RBAC_Matrix_v1.xlsx (role -> permission mapping + permission lookup sheet)
- controls_summary.pdf (2-page explanation of least-privilege enforcement, token scoping, and sync reconciliation procedures)

A couple of clarifications:
- Logs include full user emails. If you need masking for any external reviewers, tell us which fields to mask.
- SCIM exports include external_id and internal_id columns — we included both to make mapping easier for your team.

If you'd like to walk through the package and the RBAC model, I can book a 30-minute session for Fri morning (I've suggested times on the Zoom link in related_links). Karthik and Soojin will join to answer technical questions.

Please confirm receipt and whether one-off redactions are needed before sharing with your audit committee.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
